capabilities: Plan and reorganize note headings as a draggable mind map or list
Export a typeset PDF with TeX-style line breaking, footnotes, captions and tables of contents
Export a self-contained HTML reader with outline, thumbnails and dark mode
Edit formulas, tables, charts and callouts through visual editors
Configure page layout, fonts, headers and footers per note or per profile
extras: Desktop only (not available on tablets and phones); version 0.32+ requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README documents export limits (embedded notes, Dataview and Mermaid blocks are not printed) and states the plugin never connects to the internet.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visually reorganize a long document's headings or to export a typeset PDF with proper line breaking, footnotes and captions without installing LaTeX.

relations.evidence: Bigorneau asks it for the drawing, or uses its image export (SVG or PNG)
written by hand or with the Callout Manager plugin
They are drawn by the MathJax library included in the plugin

summary: Long-document writing tool that turns headings into a draggable mind map and exports a TeX-quality PDF or self-contained HTML reader without LaTeX.
